gloss: base (of a triangle); bottom of society

definitions.explanation: The bottom side of a geometric figure, especially a triangle. A standard term in mathematics education.
The lowest level or foundation of a society, organization, or hierarchy. Can refer neutrally to the grassroots or foundation, or negatively to the bottom rung of society.

examples.japanese: {三角形|さんかくけい}の{底辺|ていへん}の{長|なが}さを{求|もと}めなさい。
examples.english: Find the length of the base of the triangle.

examples.japanese: {底辺|ていへん}×{高|たか}さ÷2で{面積|めんせき}が{求|もと}められる。
examples.english: The area can be calculated with base times height divided by 2.

examples.japanese: {底辺|ていへん}が5センチ、{高|たか}さが3センチの{三角形|さんかくけい}の{面積|めんせき}を{計算|けいさん}しなさい。
examples.english: Calculate the area of a triangle with a base of 5 cm and a height of 3 cm.

examples.japanese: {社会|しゃかい}の{底辺|ていへん}で{働|はたら}く{人|ひと}たち。
examples.english: People who work at the bottom of society.

examples.japanese: {底辺|ていへん}から{這|は}い{上|あ}がった{成功者|せいこうしゃ}の{物語|ものがたり}。
examples.english: A story of a successful person who climbed up from the bottom.

examples.japanese: スポーツの{底辺|ていへん}を{広|ひろ}げることが{将来|しょうらい}の{強化|きょうか}につながる。
examples.english: Broadening the grassroots base of a sport leads to future improvement.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is a standard math term learned in school. Sense 2 can be neutral ({底辺|ていへん}を{広|ひろ}げる, broaden the base/grassroots) or negative ({社会|しゃかい}の{底辺|ていへん}, bottom of society). In recent internet slang, {底辺|ていへん} is sometimes used pejoratively to describe low-status jobs or lifestyles, which many consider offensive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {底辺|ていへん}の{長|なが}さ: length of the base
- {社会|しゃかい}の{底辺|ていへん}: bottom of society
- {底辺|ていへん}を{広|ひろ}げる: broaden the base
- {底辺|ていへん}から{這|は}い{上|あ}がる: climb up from the bottom
